about: From hubertfa-posttrain (results/trainv3/mf_release/composer/phones_fixture.json): the 150 most frequent distinct words of each language in the multilingual test songs. `sounds` is what the readers gave each word at ddceb69c (reader sounds, or vocabulary keys for a Japanese, Chinese or English word); `phones` and `rows` are what training gave hubertfa-pt-mf-s12000-line1 through hubertfa_pt_mf_phones_v1.json.
